messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — cutoff for v0.23.5 is EOD PST today (approx 23:00 PDT). We need: version bump, changelog entries, security sign-off, and a light docs sweep. Anything blocking?
priya: I'm on the changelog. Will open final PR in ~30m. Will call out breaking/careful notes.
jordan: QA: smoke tests running now against rc build. If they pass, we can approve gating tomorrow morning. ETA 45m.
lina: Security review: I still need one small dependency justification for analytics-agent. @priya can you paste the SNYK link?
priya: sure — https://snyk.io/vuln/SNYK-ANALYTICS-123 (low severity, fixed in patch). I'll add a note to the changelog and link the PR.
alex: good. If QA passes and security is ok, I'll cut the final tag. Reminder: no feature merges after cutoff — only bugfix & docs.
sam: docs: doing a quick pass on the API example pages, will push any edits to the docs/rc branch. If someone updates examples, ping me.
priya: created PR #4123 for changelog + version bump. Title: "changelog: v0.23.5 notes + bump". PTAL.
jordan: smoke ✅ — all core scenarios passed on staging-rc. Logging a couple nonblocking flaps (timing-related). Details in the test run:  https://ci.redwood/1234
alex: awesome, thanks. @lina any blocker on security sign-off now?
lina: nope, I reviewed the SNYK tile and the mitigation. Marking security review as approved. Adding comment to PR #4123.
priya: updated PR with security note and docs pointers. Also included CLI bump steps.
priya: ```bash
# release steps
git checkout main
git pull origin main
git merge --no-ff release/rc-0.23.5
bump2version patch
git push origin main
# tag and push
git tag -a v0.23.5 -m "v0.23.5"
git push origin v0.23.5
```
alex: thanks. Two ops asks: (1) canary for 15m post-cut with automatic rollback on error rate >1%? (2) keep the previous minor as fallback route for 1h.
sam: docs are green. I've added a small note in the release checklist about sample responses changing due to model quantization.
jordan: QA will monitor canary and will escalate if flakiness >2%. I'll keep an eye on latency dashboards.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: v0.23.5 -> prod (canary 15m) at 2026-03-17T23:30:00Z. Triggered by alex.
alex: thanks deploy-bot. Final checklist before tag: 
- [x] changelog PR (#4123)
- [x] security sign-off (lina)
- [x] QA smoke (jordan)
- [x] docs pass (sam)
- [ ] release notes published on website (docs owner)

priya: I'll publish release notes after tag and link them in the changelog PR.
alex: ok, cutting tag in 10m. If anyone sees urgent blocker, shout now. Otherwise I'll proceed.
lina: :thumbsup: approved.
jordan: go for it.
sam: :rocket: good luck.
alex: Tag created and pushed: v0.23.5. Starting canary now.
deploy-bot: canary started (v0.23.5) — monitoring enabled. Canary window: 15 minutes.
jordan: monitoring pass at +5m. Error rate nominal, 95th latency stable.
priya: publishing release notes now. Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/v0.23.5
priya: added docs site redirect and examples note.
alex: Canary complete, metrics look good. Promoting to full rollout.
deploy-bot: rollout 100% started for v0.23.5.
priya: changelog PR merged, release notes live.
alex: excellent. Post-release follow-ups: open a tiny cleanup PR to remove rc flags from config and add a regression test for the timing flap jordan saw. I'll create those tomorrow morning. Thanks all.
qa-bot: reminder: please file any post-release issues with label "release-hot".
priya: filed cleanup ticket #4200 for rc flags.
alex: closing thread — great job everyone. :tada:
